section.title: Rominou’s Run
section.text: A little runner game you can play right here: Rominou sets off from {city} and runs through my trips. Each level you clear unlocks that city’s postcard.

start.label: Game title screen
start.title: Rominou’s Run
start.tagline: From {first} to {last}: {count} stops, a postcard at every arrival.
start.howJump: Jump with Space, ↑ or W (or tap the screen)
start.howDouble: Press again in mid-air: double jump!
start.loading: Rominou is lacing up his sneakers…
start.error: The game couldn’t load. Check your connection and try again.

mode.label: Chill mode
mode.suggested: Turned on for you: your device asks for less motion.

map.title: Travel map
map.intro: Pick your destination: each stop you clear opens the next one.
map.best: Best: {count, plural, =0 {no stamps} one {# stamp} other {# stamps}}

hud.label: Game info
hud.hearts: {count, plural, =0 {No hearts left} one {# heart} other {# hearts}} out of {max}
hud.stamps: {count, plural, =0 {No stamps} one {# stamp} other {# stamps}}
hud.playArea: Play area, {name}. Space, up arrow or W to jump, Escape to pause.

hints.jumpKeys: An obstacle! Press Space, ↑ or W to jump.
hints.jumpTouch: An obstacle! Tap the screen to jump.
hints.stamps: Stamps in the air: jump to grab them!
hints.gap: Water ahead! Time your jump to keep your feet dry.
hints.double: Stamps way up high: press a second time in mid-air to double jump!
hints.gate: The boarding gate! Just a few more steps…
hints.tower: That pile is too tall! Press again in mid-air to double jump!

intro.geneve: Geneva, here we go! An easy start along the lake.
intro.seoul: Seoul! Hop over the kimchi jars and the bojagi parcels.
intro.toronto: Toronto! Watch out for fire hydrants… and low-flying Canada geese.
intro.brighton-dubrovnik: From Brighton Pier to the walls of Dubrovnik: mind the seagulls!
intro.paris: Paris! The croissant cart won’t stop for you.
intro.shanghai: Shanghai, on the Bund! The kites are flying low tonight.
intro.tokyo: Tokyo! Lucky cats are less lucky if you run into them.
intro.berlin: Berlin! Jump over pieces of the Wall and parked bikes.
intro.busan: Busan, the last stop! Lighthouses, boats and drones: ready?

intro2d: {name}, here we go! Cones, suitcases, benches and pigeons: time your jumps.

pause.title: Paused
pause.text: Rominou is catching his breath. Take your time!

complete.title: Postcard unlocked: {name}
complete.allDone: You’ve completed the whole journey, from {first} to {last}: every postcard is yours!

failed.title: Oops, out of hearts!
failed.text: Rominou needs a little break… Shall we try again?
failed.tryTranquille: Want more room for error? Try chill mode.

announce.hit: Ouch! {hearts, plural, =0 {No hearts left.} one {Only # heart left.} other {Only # hearts left.}}
announce.splash: Splash! {hearts, plural, =0 {No hearts left.} one {Only # heart left.} other {Only # hearts left.}}

postcard.illustration: Illustration of Geneva: the lake, the Jet d’Eau and the Alps

collection.title: My postcards
collection.intro: Clear a stop to earn its postcard.

captions.geneve: Starting point: Lake Geneva, the Jet d’Eau and the Alps. Next stop: the rest of the world!
captions.seoul: A lane of traditional houses with the tower at the end of the street: greetings from Seoul!
captions.toronto: The big TORONTO letters among the skyscrapers: the must-have photo!
captions.brighton-dubrovnik: A selfie above Dubrovnik’s old town and the sea, at sunset.
captions.paris: Arms crossed in front of the Eiffel Tower, even under a grey sky.
captions.shanghai: Pudong’s skyscrapers lit up, seen from the waterfront: Shanghai by night!
captions.tokyo: Tokyo Tower glowing orange: the city’s prettiest night light.
captions.berlin: Suitcase in hand at the Brandenburg Gate: the journey goes on!
captions.busan: A neighbourhood of colourful houses clinging to the hillside: greetings from Busan!
